guide_registration_pending.title: New tour guide registration
guide_registration_pending.message: There is a new tour guide registration that needs admin review.

guide_verified.title: Guide profile approved
guide_verified.message: Your tour guide profile has been approved. You can now receive tours.

guide_rejected.title: Guide profile not approved
guide_rejected.message: Your tour guide profile was not approved. Please review your information or contact the admin.

tour_updated.title: Tour updated
tour_updated.message: Information for tour {{tourName}} has been updated.

tour_deleted.title: Tour deleted
tour_deleted.message: Tour {{tourName}} has been removed from the system. Please review related campaigns.

tour_published.title: Tour published
tour_published.message: Tour {{tourName}} has been published and is ready for customers.

tour_unpublished.title: Tour unpublished
tour_unpublished.message: Tour {{tourName}} has been unpublished and will no longer be visible to customers.

tour_inventory_low.title: Tour inventory running low
tour_inventory_low.message: Tour {{tourName}} only has {{remainingSlots}} spots left. Please review and adjust inventory if needed.

tour_inventory_sold_out.title: Tour sold out
tour_inventory_sold_out.message: Tour {{tourName}} is sold out. Please update inventory or add more departures.

tour_inventory_restocked.title: Tour inventory restocked
tour_inventory_restocked.message: Tour {{tourName}} inventory has been increased by {{addedSlots}} spots. The tour is ready for more bookings.

tour_booking_created.title: New tour booking
tour_booking_created.message: A new booking has been created for tour {{tourName}}. Please review and confirm.

tour_booking_confirmed.title: Tour booking confirmed
tour_booking_confirmed.message: Tour booking for {{tourName}} has been confirmed. Prepare services for the guest.

tour_booking_cancelled.title: Tour booking cancelled
tour_booking_cancelled.message: Tour booking for {{tourName}} has been cancelled. Please review inventory and departures.

tour_booking_payment_failed.title: Tour booking payment failed
tour_booking_payment_failed.message: Payment for tour booking {{tourName}} failed. Please check with the customer or the payment gateway.

tour_booking_overbooking.title: Tour overbooking warning
tour_booking_overbooking.message: The system detected a possible overbooking for tour {{tourName}}. Please review inventory and adjust promptly.
